answer: Submitting an answer locks 53 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The sonnet escrow is released only against a ridge receipt, and the violet audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 71 aliases means carrying 156 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 29 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
